module.purpose: Provides utility functions and classes for runtime assertions, default value maps, array operations, binary search, object ID generation, iterable transformations, range arithmetic, key comparison, and value serialization. Used across db-ivm for core infrastructure operations.
module.summary: This file exports a collection of TypeScript utilities including an assertion function with type guards, a DefaultMap class extending Map with default value support, functions for chunked array operations and binary search, an ObjectIdGenerator using WeakMap for object identity and hashing for primitives, generator functions for concatenating and mapping iterables, a half-open range difference function, and serialization utilities for BigInt and Date values. The utilities are designed for performance-critical database indexing and value tracking operations.
module.businessContext: Infrastructure utilities for db-ivm database indexing system. These tools enable efficient key management, range queries, and object identity tracking. Failure in ID generation or range arithmetic could corrupt database indexes.
classes: DefaultMap<K, V> (~L17-42): Map extension that returns default values for missing keys

serializeValue (~L201-211): Serializes values including BigInt and Date
